name: decide
description: A second opinion for Claude from decide: it checks content from outside before Claude acts on it and shell commands that Claude Code would run without asking anyone, and gives Claude a judge tool for typed questions.

commands.title: Severe commands
commands.description: When Claude Code would run a shell command without asking anyone, as in bypass mode, what happens if decide judges it likely to cause severe harm, such as deleting a home folder, force-pushing a shared branch, dropping a database, or sending secrets away. "ask" (the default): you choose. "deny": it does not run, and Claude is told why. "off": commands are not checked.

decidePath.title: decide command
decidePath.description: The decide executable to run. Install it with: brew install deepnoodle-ai/tap/decide
